import numpy as np
from scipy.optimize import least_squares
eps=np.asarray(df['eps']);T=np.asarray(df['T']);s=np.asarray(df['sigma'])
V=np.var(s)
models={
 'A':(lambda p: p[0]*eps**p[1]*T**p[2]*np.exp(-p[3]*eps/T)+p[4]*eps**p[5]*T**p[6], 7),
 'B':(lambda p: p[0]*T**p[1]*eps**p[2]*np.exp(-p[3]*eps)+p[4]*T**p[5], 6),
 'C':(lambda p: p[0]*eps**p[1]*np.exp(p[2]/T)+p[3]*T**p[4], 5),
 'E':(lambda p: p[0]*T**p[1]*(1-np.exp(-p[2]*eps))+p[3]*T**p[4]*eps**p[5], 6),
 'H':(lambda p: p[0]*eps**p[1]*T**p[2]*np.exp(-p[3]*T)+p[4]*T**p[5]*eps**p[6], 7),
}
rng=np.random.default_rng(0)
out=[]
for name,(f,k) in models.items():
    best=(9,None)
    for trial in range(8):
        p0=rng.normal(0,1,k)
        try:
            with np.errstate(all='ignore'):
                r=least_squares(lambda p: f(p)-s, p0, max_nfev=400)
            v=np.mean((f(r.x)-s)**2)/V
            if np.isfinite(v) and v<best[0]: best=(v,r.x)
        except Exception as ex: pass
    out.append(f"{name} {best[0]:.3e} {np.round(best[1],4) if best[1] is not None else None}")
print("\n".join(out))
